content.text:
"Geplant" and "Verfügbar" now sit at the right end of the employee row. When the grid is wider than the window, they stay at the window's right edge as you scroll sideways.

I checked both cases in the running app:
- **Wide window (1800px):** the stats end at the right edge of the row, like in [planning-wide.png](.playwright-mcp/planning-wide.png).
- **Narrow window (1100px):** the stats stay at the window's right edge, like in [planning-narrow.png](.playwright-mcp/planning-narrow.png).

**What changed:**
- `block_header_info_cell` in [planning_shared.py](components/alloq-project/src/alloq_project/components/planning_shared.py) takes a new optional `end=[...]` argument. Whatever you pass there is pinned to the right. The info tooltip now sits on the stats instead of on the action buttons.
- The employee row in [planning_grid.py:166](components/alloq-project/src/alloq_project/components/planning_grid.py:166) now passes the two stats through `end`.
- There is a new test in [test_planning_grid_rendering.py](components/alloq-project/tests/test_planning_grid_rendering.py).

All 398 project tests pass and ruff is clean. Nothing is committed.

**Things to know:**
- I left the project view as it was. If you want its "Geplant" and role totals on the right too, it only needs `end=` there as well.
- Other edits to these planning files were happening while I worked. The new `test_planning_readability.py` from that work currently breaks the test run with a collection error and has 4 ruff errors, so I left it out of my test run.
